Compare explicit QC policies on an existing 2D/3D trajectory dataset

Source: R/scientific-core2.R
aqt_qc_sensitivity.Rd

This is a non-destructive sensitivity audit: all observed source rows remain traceable in a per-policy ledger. Position coordinates, units and time are taken exactly as supplied to `aqt_tracks()`. Optional frame_id, when present, must increase strictly inside each scoped track. Nonadjacent acquisition frames are NEVER treated as an observed movement step, even when elapsed time is below a chosen threshold. It does not estimate missing positions.

Usage

aqt_qc_sensitivity(tracks, gap_limits_s, speed_limits = Inf, step_limits = Inf)

Arguments

tracks

A validated `aqt_tracks` object, in 2D image or 2D/3D tank coordinates.

gap_limits_s

Finite positive maximum consecutive-step durations in seconds.

speed_limits

Finite positive maximum speeds in coordinate units/s; Inf disables.

step_limits

Finite positive maximum displacements in coordinate units; Inf disables.

Value

List with `policies`, `summary` (one row per track and policy), `ledger` (one row per original input observation and policy), `source_sha256`, `units`, `dimension` and `coordinate_system`. Policy sensitivity is NOT empirical measurement accuracy or inferential uncertainty.
